notes.title: JARPUG VR + not VR Stream! Late night JRPG/platformer time.
notes.notes:
It is time for the goggles. Wish me luck! My huge face doesn't quite work with the max IPD of the Quest 2, but I'll blunder through for your amusement. And then I'll try and show off the "flat" screen mode and some Steam Deck gameplay. Happy Steam Next Fest! Come [check out the demo](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2474010/JARPUG/) for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44270474/f2ebff67de9d7a6e9d3b0157074f1cfd6ed7cd82.png[/img]

And hey, if the [Kickstarter](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/floatingislandgames/jarpug) works out maybe I can get a headset that actually fits my eyes!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest JARPUG demopalooza
notes.notes:
OH JOY! I'll be streaming JARPUG in flat mode so you can watch and ask questions. Also, JARPUG's demo is out NOW on Steam! Go check the store page and click that pretty green button!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44270474/f2ebff67de9d7a6e9d3b0157074f1cfd6ed7cd82.png[/img]

During the stream I'll talk about the game and [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/floatingislandgames/jarpug]THE KICKSTARTER![/url][/b]

I may stream in VR next time, but I don't really know how to interact with the stream effectively while doing that, so I might just prerecord that one. The chances of me just turning off the stream on accident while I'm buried in VR goggles would be PRETTY HIGH.
